scope: Exploratory full-acquisition epoch position-error alert and planar-filter evaluation; not NLOS retraining or an untouched benchmark.
selection_basis: Fixed by published scenario identities before computing this branch's positioning errors: medium urban train, deep urban validation, harsh urban test. No random epoch split or test-based selection.
solver: RTKLIB broadcast single-frequency GPS/BeiDou SPP weighted least squares
limitations: Only three drives, one receiver/antenna configuration and one city; area and date are confounded.
These acquisitions were already inspected for NLOS classification; this is a new positioning task, not a globally blind final benchmark.
One whole test acquisition yields more epochs but only one independent test drive.
SPP solver differs from the GSDC-derived-data adapter; scores must not be pooled without recording that difference.
SPAN reference quality and time guards affect evaluation coverage; all removed/failed epochs must be reported.
No raw IMU integration, TDCP, RTK ambiguity resolution or NLOS-prediction-driven positioning in this branch.
